# Contact Improv Koh Phangan

> Contact Improvisation (CI) community on Koh Phangan, Thailand: workshops, retreats, jams and classes, January to May 2027.

## 2027 workshops and jams

- [Root & Wind](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/root-wind/): 26th - 30th January, 5-day Intensive Bari Kim
- [Focused Jams Week 1&2](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/focused-jams-week-1-2/): 1st - 14th February, Closed Group Jam Container
- [Foundations](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/foundations/): 2nd & 3rd February, 2 Day Beginner's Workshop with Christina Dohr
- [Aikido into CI](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/aikido-into-ci/): 5th & 6th February, 2 Day workshop with Christina Dohr
- [Deep Touch](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/deep-touch/): 8th - 10th February, 3-Day Workshop with Rosalind Holgate-Smith
- [As One Body](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/as-one-body/): 11th - 13th February, 3- Day Workshop with Krid & Ing from DD Flection
- [To Be Danced By Spaces](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/to-be-danced-by-spaces/): 15th - 17th February, 3-Day Workshop with Nitipat Ong Pholchai
- [The Body Orchestra](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/the-body-orchestra/): 18th - 28th February, Axis Syllabus - Somatics - CI with Kira Kirsch
- [Oneness Nowness](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/oneness-nowness/): 1st - 7th March, From Nature to Studio with Yasukichi Suzuki
- [Focused Jams Week 3&4](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/focused-jams-week-3-4/): 1st - 14th March, Closed Group Jam Container
- [Capoeira and Soft Acrobatics into CI](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/capoeira-and-soft-acrobatics-into-ci/): 3rd & 4th March, 2 Day Workshop with Nuria Bowart
- [Listening to Movement](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/listening-to-movement/): 15th - 19th March, 5-Day Intensive with Antoine Ragot
- [Katya Basalaeva](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/katya-basalaeva/): 20th - 28th March, 5-Day Intensive & 3-Day Lab with Katya Basalaeva
- [Focused Jams Week 5&6](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/focused-jams-week-5-6/): 29th March - 11th April, Closed Group Jam Container
- [Xenia Isaeva](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/xenia-isaeva/): 6th & 7th April, 2 Day Workshop
- [Soft Power](https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/workshops/soft-power/): 9th April - 19th April, 10 day intensive with Artem Markov

Machine-readable: https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/events.json and https://perpetualengine.github.io/contactimprovkohphangan-demo/calendar.ics
